explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/802: Shearer improved the bound to ≫_r (log t / (log log(t+1)·t))·n. The Lean statement adds the hypothesis 2 ≤ averageDegree and asserts c·(log t / (log(log(t+1))·t))·n ≤ indepNum G for K_r-free G. The restriction is necessary and documented: log log(t+1) vanishes at t = e − 1 ≈ 1.72, so without it the bound is unbounded/negative near there; for t ≥ 2 the factor is positive and bounded, so the asymptotic result gives a uniform constant. Faithful.
